headline: WebHarbor releases 153 local web-agent environments and 3,518 tasks; authors report transfer gains for one 4B agent
summary: A 2 November 2026 arXiv preprint and its linked project repository describe WebHarbor, a collection of 153 Dockerized website environments and 3,518 tasks for GUI-agent evaluation and reinforcement-learning training. The paper reports that WebHarbor-4B scored 75.8 on average across WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web, versus 70.6 for an online-RL OpenWebRL-4B baseline under the authors’ setup. These are author-reported results from one trained 4B model. The environments reconstruct task-relevant parts of real sites; the paper says some interactive features are approximated and that synthetic performance does not guarantee safe or equivalent performance on live websites.
